title: ModelInput
description: Canonical ML inference input: normalized surface tensor plus metadata. ADR-010: hybrid consumes a T-day lookback window. Hard contract — inference consumes exactly this (RULE 5).

shape.description: [T, 7, H, W] for the hybrid (Stage 2, ADR-010); [7, H, W] single-day for the CNN baseline comparator (Stage 1). T must equal the checkpoint's stored lookback_days.

values.description: Normalized floats. Hybrid: [T, 7, H, W]; Stage-1 CNN: [7, H, W].

channel_order.description: SST, SSS, SSH/SLA, current_U, current_V, wind_U, wind_V (LOCKED ordering).

normalization_version.description: Must equal the checkpoint's stored normalization version.

lookback_days.description: T for the hybrid window (ADR-010). 1 for the Stage-1 CNN baseline.
